title: Among all Dutch drivers born between 1980 and 1997 who have at least one wi
question: Among all Dutch drivers born between 1980 and 1997 who have at least one win in their career, find the one with the highest total points across all races. Return their full name, nationality, age as of today, and the total number of wins they accumulated.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  d."XCL_038" AS forename,
  d."XCL_039" AS surname,
  d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
  CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(d."XCL_040")) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r."XCL_079" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wins
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON d."XCL_034" = r."XCL_075"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'Dutch'
  AND d."XCL_040" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
GROUP BY d."XCL_034", d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039", d."XCL_041", d."XCL_040"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r."XCL_079" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
ORDER BY SUM(r."XCL_082") DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  d."XCL_038" AS forename,
  d."XCL_039" AS surname,
  d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
  CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(d."XCL_040")) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r."XCL_079" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wins
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON d."XCL_034" = r."XCL_075"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'Dutch'
  AND d."XCL_040" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
GROUP BY d."XCL_034", d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039", d."XCL_041", d."XCL_040"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r."XCL_079" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
ORDER BY SUM(r."XCL_082") DESC
LIMIT 1

  d."XCL_038" AS forename,
  d."XCL_039" AS surname,
  d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
  CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(d."XCL_040")) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r."XCL_079" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wins
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON d."XCL_034" = r."XCL_075"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'Dutch'
  AND d."XCL_040" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
GROUP BY d."XCL_034", d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039", d."XCL_041", d."XCL_040"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r."XCL_079" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
ORDER BY SUM(r."XCL_082") DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d."XCL_038" || ' ' || d."XCL_039" AS full_name,
       d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
       CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(d."XCL_040",1,4) AS INTEGER) AS age,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r WHERE r."XCL_075" = d."XCL_034" AND r."XCL_077" = 1) AS total_wins
FROM drivers d
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'Dutch'
  AND CAST(substr(d."XCL_040",1,4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1997
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r WHERE r."XCL_075" = d."XCL_034" AND r."XCL_077" = 1) >= 1
ORDER BY (SELECT SUM(ds."XCL_033") FROM driverStandings ds WHERE ds."XCL_029" = d."XCL_034") DESC
LIMIT 1
